provenance.paper_title: Episodic Memory Verbalization using Hierarchical Representations of Life-Long Robot Experience

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Multimodal experience streams are grouped/summarized into a tree. LLM agent explores history tree for QA/verbalization.
During operation, Episodic Memory Verbalization applies episodic or hierarchical summarization to episodic memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
History tree grows with ongoing robot experience. For Episodic Memory Verbalization, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of episodic memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (episodic memory) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
